knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A missed calibration means the chemical uses in that period could have been compromised, so they are logged.
Industrial chemicals and glass instruments are an unsafe combination, so the sample forbids the practice.
The interval should come from the maker's instructions and the product's directions, checked against the business's own rule.

practicalCriteria: The learner checks a supplied calibration record, identifies any missed entry and writes the corrective action note.
The learner moves a supplied incompatible glass measure to a safe location and records why.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Stop mixing with any instrument whose calibration is missing or unknown until it is checked.
Stop mixing any product where the compatibility of the instrument cannot be checked.
